title: Clean and organize your messy Excel CSV spreadsheet data
description:
Messy data? I'll clean it up fast.

I help businesses and individuals transform messy, unorganized spreadsheets into clean, usable data — delivered within 24 hours.

**What I'll do:**
✅ Remove duplicate rows and records
✅ Fix inconsistent formatting (dates, phone numbers, addresses)
✅ Standardize text (capitalization, spacing, naming conventions)
✅ Merge multiple files into one organized dataset
✅ Add calculations, categories, and summaries
✅ Convert PDF/text data into structured spreadsheets
✅ Make your data presentation-ready

**Why choose me:**
⚡ 24-hour delivery
🔄 Unlimited revisions until you're satisfied
🔒 100% confidential — your data is never shared
💬 Fast, clear communication

**Pricing:**
📊 BASIC — $15 — Up to 100 rows cleaned
📊 STANDARD — $35 — Up to 500 rows cleaned  
📊 PREMIUM — $60 — Up to 2,000 rows cleaned

Need more than 2,000 rows? Message me for a custom quote.

Let's get your data clean and organized. Order now or message me with questions!

faq.question: What file formats do you accept?
faq.answer: I accept CSV, XLSX, XLS, Google Sheets links, and PDF files with tables.

faq.question: How fast can you deliver?
faq.answer: Standard delivery is 24 hours. Rush delivery available for an additional fee.

faq.question: Do you keep my data?
faq.answer: No. All data is deleted after project completion. I treat your data as strictly confidential.
